from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CapitalSurplusEntry(BaseModel):
    """A capital surplus figure found in one company's financial statements."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company the filing belongs to")
    capital_surplus_value: float | None = Field(description="The additional paid-in capital amount as reported; None if not found in this document")
    label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written in the document (e.g., 'Additional paid-in capital')")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The period end date of the financial statement")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt with the value")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    capital_surplus_entries: list[CapitalSurplusEntry]
